comment: Mutation testing for the SHIPPED RUNTIME assembly. A THIRD config because Stryker mutates one 'project' per run. Registry members, MapConfig, the IDwarfMapper facade and the exception types have no derivable case-space the way an attribute does — there is no AttributeUsage to decompose and no endpoint matrix to cross them against — so a surviving mutant is the only non-textual proof that a case is untested. This is what makes AmbiguousInterfaces and DestinationType (zero references in any test family, round 18) impossible rather than merely noticed. test-projects is DELIBERATELY not DwarfMapper.Generator.Tests: that project's references to the runtime types are overwhelmingly assertions over EMITTED SOURCE TEXT, not executions of this assembly, and its one genuine runtime executor (AutoValidateRuntimeTests) exercises Register/IsProvided paths that IntegrationTests already drives directly — at a fraction of the wall-clock. Run via scripts/housekeeping.ps1 -Mutation (needs: dotnet tool install -g dotnet-stryker). MEASUREMENT PENDING — break stays 0 until a run reports a score. NOTE: 'comment' lives OUTSIDE the 'stryker-config' object because Stryker 4.16 REJECTS unknown keys inside it — the two sibling configs kept theirs inside and could not run at all until this was found.
